## Walkthrough

Adds K8s version detection and conditional test logic to provision the ClusterProfile secretreader plugin via beta image volumes on K8s >= v1.35.0, with init-container fallback for older clusters; aligns Dockerfile binary path; selects and pulls the appropriate plugin image; and improves test helper reporting.

## Changes

**Image Volume Conditional Support**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Kubernetes version detection helper** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|Adds `e2e_supports_image_volume` that checks whether the kind node Kubernetes version is >= v1.35.0.|
|**Plugin image selection and docker preparation** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|When `CLUSTERPROFILE_VERSION` is set, conditionally select the official `registry.k8s.io/.../secretreader:${CLUSTERPROFILE_VERSION}` for supported K8s versions or the staging `.../secretreader-plugin:${CLUSTERPROFILE_PLUGIN_IMAGE_VERSION}` for older clusters; extend `prepare_docker_images` to pull the chosen image.|
|**Dockerfile binary path alignment** <br> `hack/testing/secretreader/Dockerfile`|Final image copies built plugin binary to `/bin/secretreader-plugin` instead of `/secretreader-plugin` to match mount/init-container expectations.|
|**Test deployment volume strategy** <br> `test/e2e/multikueue/sequential/e2e_test.go`|Remove old version import, reorder plugin constants and comments, parse server version with `versionutil.ParseGeneric`, compute `useImageVolume` via `AtLeast(v1.35.0)`, append `ImageVolumeSource`-backed `corev1.Volume` when true, and change init-container command to `sh -c` that creates `bin` and copies `/bin/secretreader-plugin` into the shared path.|
|**Test helper reporting** <br> `test/util/e2e.go`|Call `ginkgo.GinkgoHelper()` at the start of `GetClusterProfilePluginImage` for correct failure attribution.|

### Review by [@vladikkuzn](https://github.com/vladikkuzn) (commented) — 2026-06-11T19:04:23Z

- **test/e2e/multikueue/sequential/e2e_test.go:549** by [@vladikkuzn](https://github.com/vladikkuzn) — 2026-06-11T19:04:23Z
```diff
@@ -537,7 +546,7 @@ var _ = ginkgo.Describe("MultiKueue Sequential", func() {
 								Name(pluginContainerName).
 								Image(util.GetClusterProfilePluginImage()).
 								ImagePullPolicy(corev1.PullIfNotPresent).
-								Command("cp", "/secretreader-plugin", secretReaderPath).
+								Command("sh", "-c", fmt.Sprintf("mkdir -p %s/bin && cp /bin/secretreader-plugin %s", volumeMountPath, secretReaderPath)).
```

  cp fails on the init-container path (k8s < 1.35):                                                                                                                                          
    - The volume is a fresh EmptyDir mounted at /plugins. /plugins/bin/ doesn't exist yet, and cp won't create parent dirs → cp: can't create '/plugins/bin/...': No such file or directory. So the mkdir -p is    
    genuinely required
